case_number: 2024 INSC 297; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) No. 8867 of 2022)
summary: SARFAESI Act enforcement; auction validity; alternative remedy vs writ jurisdiction; Borrower's non-compliance with DRT's deposit condition; OTS rejection; Sale Certificate validity; High Court erred in exercising writ jurisdiction where statutory appeal available; interim stay vacated automatically upon default; dismissal of securitization application as withdrawn; restoration of application improper.
final_judgment: High Court judgment set aside; writ petition dismissed; auction purchaser's rights upheld; appeal allowed.
